Container.Name: circuit-breaker-tracker
Container.Overview:
Recreate your electrical panels, label every breaker and what it serves, share them with scoped access, and print panel directories.
The app runs as user 1000 inside the container. Before the first start, make the appdata folder writable for it, from the Unraid terminal: mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/circuit-breaker-tracker && chown -R 1000:1000 /mnt/user/appdata/circuit-breaker-tracker
Then open the web UI and create the first admin account. Everything else (public address, reverse proxy, Microsoft or Authentik sign-in and groups, link lifetimes, logging) is set by an admin under Settings in the app.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port the web UI listens on. With host networking this must be free on the server. If you change it, open the UI at that port.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Holds the database (breakers.db). Must be owned by 1000:1000 (see Overview).

Config.Name: First admin username
Config.Description: Optional. Creates the first admin at startup instead of using the setup screen. Ignored once any user exists.

Config.Name: First admin password
Config.Description: Optional, with the username above. At least 10 characters.
